title: Integration of genotyping by sequencing and machine learning for genome-wide identification of informative markers for body weight in broiler chickens.
authors: Bani Saadat, Hossein; Vaez Torshizi, Rasoul; Masoudi, Ali Akbar
one_liner_zh: 该研究用GBS和机器学习识别肉鸡体重相关SNP标记，属于畜禽育种基因组关联分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Identifying associations between single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and economically important traits is fundamental to modern poultry breeding programs. However, genome-wide studies based on commercial high-density SNP arrays are often prohibitively expensive, particularly for large populations and in resource-limited settings. Therefore, this study employed a cost-effective genotyping-by-sequencing (GBS) approach combined with two ensemble machine learning algorithms, Random Forest (RF) and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), to identify informative markers of body weight (BW) at hatch, 3 weeks (BW3), and 6 weeks (BW6) of age in broiler chickens derived from reciprocal crosses between the commercial Arian line and native Urmia chicken. A total of 368 birds were genotyped using GBS, and 312 second-generation (F(2)) birds with complete phenotypic records were utilized for genomic screening and machine learning analyses. The hyperparameters of both machine learning algorithms were optimized using a grid search with three-fold cross-validation. The combined application of RF and GBM identified several informative SNP markers located on chromosomes 1, 4, 13, 17, 19, 20, and 24. Positional candidate genes located within these genomic regions included platelet-derived growth factor D (PDGFD), KIRRE-like nephrin family adhesion molecule 3 (KIRREL3), ETS proto-oncogene 1, transcription factor (ETS1), acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 1 (ACSL1), diacylglycerol O-acyltransferase 2 (DGAT2), and selenophosphate synthetase 1 (SEPHS1). Gene Ontology enrichment analysis indicated that these genes are involved in biological processes related to the regulation of protein degradation, immune responses, and lipid metabolism. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating cost-effective GBS with machine learning approaches to identify genomic regions and informative markers for body weight in broiler chickens, providing valuable genomic resources for future breeding and genetic improvement programs.
abstract_zh: 识别单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）与经济重要性状之间的关联是现代家禽育种计划的基础。然而，基于商业高密度SNP芯片的全基因组研究通常成本过高，尤其是在大规模群体和资源有限的环境中。因此，本研究采用了一种经济有效的基因分型测序（GBS）方法，并结合两种集成机器学习算法——随机森林（RF）和梯度提升机（GBM），以识别肉鸡在孵化时、3周龄（BW3）和6周龄（BW6）体重（BW）的信息性标记，这些肉鸡来自商业Arian品系与本地Urmia鸡之间的正反交。共对368只鸟进行了GBS基因分型，并利用312只具有完整表型记录的第二代（F(2)）个体进行基因组筛选和机器学习分析。两种机器学习算法的超参数通过三折交叉验证的网格搜索进行优化。RF和GBM的联合应用识别了位于1、4、13、17、19、20和24号染色体上的多个信息性SNP标记。这些基因组区域内的位置候选基因包括血小板衍生生长因子D（PDGFD）、KIRRE样nephrin家族粘附分子3（KIRREL3）、ETS原癌基因1、转录因子（ETS1）、酰基辅酶A合成酶长链家族成员1（ACSL1）、二酰甘油O-酰基转移酶2（DGAT2）和硒磷酸合成酶1（SEPHS1）。基因本体富集分析表明，这些基因参与与蛋白质降解调控、免疫反应和脂质代谢相关的生物过程。这些发现证明了将经济有效的GBS与机器学习方法相结合以识别肉鸡体重基因组区域和信息性标记的潜力，为未来的育种和遗传改良计划提供了宝贵的基因组资源。
